summary: The change adds the deterministic PR-contract pre-flight (open-issue and named-path checks, no resolution judgment), wires it before the reviewer with an auto-revert skip, extends CI lint/format/mypy to scripts plus a --help smoke test, fixes the wait_for_ci.py mypy error, and resolves both shellcheck warnings. Host CI shows Validate workflows and all ci legs green, and tests cover the required contract behavior.
